answer: Anyone thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 19 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The lagoon counter is kept in river and oasis shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 19 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3390 identities would post 2886 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
